paper.title_en: Revisiting the gamma-ray signal from light ALPs emitted during the evaporation of memory-burdened PBHs
paper.abstract_en: The memory-burden effect was recently proposed to take into account the information back-reaction in the evaporation of primordial black holes (PBHs). In this work, we systematically explore the axion-like particle (ALP) production via the evaporation of memory-burdened PBHs and the subsequent ALP-photon conversion in cosmic magnetic fields. The PBH evaporation progress is divided in the semiclassical phase of Hawking radiation and the quantum memory-burden phase. The time evolution of PBH mass and the gamma-ray flux after the conversion of PBH-emitted ALP are then evaluated by considering the memory-burden induced PBH entropy suppression. Furthermore, we investigate the detection prospects of this evaporation-conversion signal in next-generation satellite telescopes, including AMEGO, e-ASTROGAM and MAST. The detectable PBH mass range is extended down to masses much smaller than $10^{15}$ g. Applying the Fisher forecasting method, we derive the projected sensitivity for PBH fraction $f_{\rm PBH}$ and ALP-photon coupling $g_{aγγ}$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文结合记忆负担效应对原初黑洞蒸发、轴子类粒子产生及ALP-光子转化进行系统研究，涉及黑洞热力学与霍金辐射的半经典与量子阶段划分，理论深度较高；使用Fisher预报方法给出未来卫星探测灵敏度，方法信号明确，且将可探测原初黑洞质量范围扩展至远低于10^15 g，具有一定新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 重新审视记忆负担原初黑洞蒸发过程中发射的轻轴子类粒子产生的伽马射线信号
decision.abstract_zh: 记忆负担效应最近被提出，用以在原初黑洞（PBH）蒸发过程中考虑信息反作用。在本工作中，我们系统地研究了通过记忆负担原初黑洞蒸发产生轴子类粒子（ALP）以及随后在宇宙磁场中发生的ALP-光子转化。PBH蒸发过程被划分为霍金辐射的半经典阶段和量子记忆负担阶段。随后，通过考虑记忆负担引起的PBH熵抑制，评估了PBH质量的时间演化以及PBH发射的ALP转化后的伽马射线通量。此外，我们研究了下一代卫星望远镜（包括AMEGO、e-ASTROGAM和MAST）对这一蒸发-转化信号的探测前景。可探测的PBH质量范围被下延至远小于$10^{15}$ g的质量。应用Fisher预报方法，我们导出了对PBH比例$f_{\rm PBH}$和ALP-光子耦合$g_{aγγ}$的预期灵敏度。
